description: This file contains tests for a FastAPI application, utilizing pytest fixtures and the TestClient to verify that API routes such as '/docs', '/redoc', and '/users/john' return the correct responses and contain expected content.

methods.name: client()
methods.description: A pytest fixture that sets up a TestClient for the FastAPI application, creating a static directory for testing purposes and cleaning up afterward.

methods.name: test_swagger_ui_html(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that the Swagger UI documentation page loads successfully and contains expected script and style URLs.

methods.name: test_swagger_ui_oauth2_redirect_html(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that the OAuth2 redirect page loads correctly and contains specific JavaScript redirection code.

methods.name: test_redoc_html(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Verifies that the ReDoc documentation page loads appropriately and contains the ReDoc JavaScript bundle URL.

methods.name: test_api(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that the '/users/john' endpoint responds with a message greeting 'john'.
